UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated researcher profile storing private account metadata isolated by owner UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the research notebook.

email.description: Verified email address of the signed-in user (PII, owner-only).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

SavedGenome.title: SavedGenome
SavedGenome.description: A user-saved CRISPR splicing configuration from the Gene Lab Simulator.

label.description: Human-readable name for the spliced genome profile.

geneIds.description: Bounded list (1 to 6 items) of spliced gene identifiers from the superhuman vault.

SavedTerm.title: SavedTerm
SavedTerm.description: A genetic glossary term bookmarked by the user from the floating info card overlay.

termKey.description: Canonical slug identifier matching the glossary dictionary.

termLabel.description: Display label of the bookmarked genetic term.

category.description: Scientific discipline category of the term.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account documents containing PII, accessible strictly by the owning authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/savedGenomes/{genomeId}.description: User's saved CRISPR gene splicing profiles and research notes.

/users/{userId}/savedTerms/{termId}.description: User's bookmarked glossary terms from the floating info cards.
